description: O Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data exige converter sensoriamento remoto espacial em inteligência agrícola prescritiva, integrando telemetria térmica e hídrica das missões ECOSTRESS e SMAP com dados espectrais do HLS (Landsat-Sentinel) para anteceder o estresse hídrico vegetal (CWSI) e anomalias de biomassa, permitindo calibrar irrigações, proteger safras e mitigar riscos climáticos com base em evidências orbitais de alta precisão.
summary:
Field Shift is a space-powered agricultural water intelligence platform developed by team Rota Terra that eliminates guesswork in farm irrigation using NASA open space data. We fuse thermal data from ECOSTRESS (canopy temperature and evapotranspiration), soil moisture via SMAP, vegetation indices via HLS, and meteorological feeds from NASA POWER to calculate the Crop Water Stress Index (CWSI) in real time at the field-plot level.

Facing extreme climate volatility and severe droughts that devastate harvests and deplete global freshwater reserves, the system converts complex geospatial matrices into a simple, actionable mobile interface. It notifies farmers with surgical precision on when and how much to irrigate (exact volume in millimeters and optimal timing windows), preventing crop dehydration days before visible signs of wilting appear.

In doing so, we transform planetary space telemetry into active climate resilience: preventing over-irrigation, reducing pumping energy costs, protecting crop yields, saving billions of liters of water, and securing global food supply.
details: Field Shift is a space-powered agricultural water intelligence platform developed by team Rota Terra to eliminate guesswork in farm irrigation by fusing NASA’s ECOSTRESS thermal data, SMAP soil moisture telemetry, HLS vegetation indices, and NASA POWER meteorological feeds to calculate the Crop Water Stress Index (CWSI) in real time at the field-plot level. Developed using Python (geopandas, rasterio, rioxarray, numpy, pandas) alongside modern web/mobile design frameworks (Figma, Lucide Icons, React/TypeScript), the platform addresses the devastating impact of extreme climate volatility and droughts by translating complex multi-sensor spatial matrices into an intuitive, low-friction mobile dashboard featuring automated, predictive irrigation recommendations (such as exact timing, recommended volume in millimeters, and optimal irrigation windows). By creatively democratizing thermal space science into a single consumer-grade metric, Field Shift transforms planetary space telemetry into active climate resilience on the ground—preventing over-irrigation, reducing pumping energy costs, protecting crop yields, saving billions of liters of freshwater globally, and empowering small-to-large-scale farmers to secure global food supply.
